name: OpenWorld Inc.
summary: VerifyMe, Inc. engages in the provision of software driven predictive analytics logistics. It operates through the Precision Logistics and Authentication segments. The Precision Logistics segment specializes in predictive analytics for optimizing delivery of time and temperature sensitive perishable products. The Authentication segment focuses on the anti-counterfeit and brand protection. The company was founded by Norman A. Gardner on November 10, 1999 and is headquartered in Lake Mary, FL.
